tree.name: AI 모델 및 엔진
tree.description: Core models and the engines that run them.

children.name: 기초 모델 (Foundation Models)
children.description: Large-scale models, frontier models, and open-weight models that serve as the core reasoning engine.

children.name: 추론 및 특화 모델 (Specialized & Reasoning Models)
children.description: Models optimized for specific modalities (vision, audio) or specific tasks like reasoning and technical workflows.

children.name: 모델 실행 및 서빙 (Inference & Model Serving)
children.description: Engines, frameworks, and local runners used to deploy, serve, and execute AI models.

tree.name: AI 에이전트 및 어시스턴트
tree.description: Agents and assistants that do work on a person's behalf.

children.name: 코딩 에이전트 (Coding Agents & Assistants)
children.description: Tools and agents specifically designed to automate software development, coding, and technical engineering tasks.

children.name: 범용 및 개인용 에이전트 (General & Personal Agents)
children.description: AI agents designed for professional knowledge work, personal assistance, or general workflow management.

tree.name: 에이전트 인프라 및 도구
tree.description: Infrastructure that lets agents run and connect to the outside world.

children.name: 에이전트 오케스트레이션 (Agent Orchestration & Harnesses)
children.description: Frameworks and harnesses that manage model execution, tool integration, and multi-agent coordination.

children.name: 연결 및 게이트웨이 (Connectivity & Gateways)
children.description: Protocols, APIs, and gateways that connect agents to external tools, servers, and model providers.

tree.name: 데이터 및 개발 인프라
tree.description: General development infrastructure for storing data and managing or running code.

children.name: 데이터베이스 및 저장소 (Databases & Storage)
children.description: Analytical, relational, or single-file databases used for storing and querying data.

children.name: 개발 및 실행 환경 (Development & Runtime Environments)
children.description: Version control systems, serverless runtimes, and workspaces used for managing code and executing applications.

tree.name: 평가 및 기타
tree.description: Methods and tools that measure and compare models and agents.

children.name: 벤치마크 (Benchmarks)
children.description: Standardized tools and metrics used to evaluate the performance of AI models and agents.
